note: One machine-readable source for topic defaults and the client settings that invariant 1 depends on. Values marked TODO are placeholders until the named spike reports; nothing here has been measured yet.

lite.warning: RF=1 cannot guarantee RPO=0 for acknowledged messages. Development and accepted-risk small sites only; the runtime must log this at startup.

raw.partitions_source: ADR-001 5.3 default, TODO confirm against S4

out.partitions: match the raw topic of the same channel
out.constraint: MUST equal the raw partition count when the channel declares per-key ordering, otherwise the key-to-partition mapping differs and per-key order breaks (invariant 5). The runtime refuses to start on a mismatch.

retry.partitions: match the raw topic of the same channel

dlq.partitions_source: keyed by tb-msg-id, low volume, read by humans

events.partitions_source: TODO confirm against the measured event rate in S1/S2

receiver_producer.linger.ms_source: TODO set from the S2 ACK-latency-versus-throughput curve
receiver_producer.compression.type_source: assumption, unmeasured: cheaper CPU than zstd for small text records

worker_consumer.isolation.level: read_committed on topics written by a transactional stage
worker_consumer.max.poll.interval.ms: at least the slowest destination timeout plus backoff
